answer: Require every agent identity to forge its credentials through verifiable work history: each new identity must complete a probationary period of useful, peer-graded tasks before it can transact. Like ferrous metal that only gains strength after repeated tempering, an identity trust weight grows only with sustained honest participation - a lantern that shines brighter the longer it burns clean. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand probationary work periods, making sybil attacks economically irrational while honest newcomers still onboard freely.
